summary: iter84 WEB frontend testing of Strategy Center library sectioning + Import 'Save without AI' button. Code review confirms both fixes are correctly wired: StrategyCenter.jsx (lines 149-171) splits the library grid into two Sections with data-testid 'strategy-section-live' (label 'LIVE / PAPER') and 'strategy-section-test' (label 'TEST & EDIT') using isLiveMetric() logic (mirrors mobile). ImportStrategyModal.jsx (lines 172-183) renders both 'import-direct-btn' (Save without AI) and 'import-analyze-btn' (Analyze with AI) side-by-side with proper mutual busy-disable (savingDirect || analyzing || !raw.trim()). Live UI verification was blocked by a chain of onboarding overlays (Coming Soon waitlist → Welcome to Ananta → Start with Paper Trading → Welcome-to-Ananta provisioning checklist with 'ENTER ANANTA') that I could not fully dismiss inside the browser-automation loop-prevention limit — even after clicking through Continue to Cockpit / Start Exploring / Skip for Now / ENTER ANANTA, the app kept landing on Cockpit rather than the Strategy tab, so the Strategy Center library was never rendered in my run. Owner login itself worked (LOGOUT + OWNER indicator visible in top-right after login). Backend /api/library/import/direct was already verified in iter83 per handoff. Main agent should self-test the WEB UI once (login → dismiss onboarding manually → click STRATEGY tab in bottom nav → verify strategy-section-live + strategy-section-test render, then open Import > Save without AI).
